_readme: Published Jumper anchors. One anchor per video is all it takes: the
recording runs in real time, so streamStart = matchTime - videoSec and
every other match on that video follows by arithmetic.
To add an event, use anchor-tool.html (run locally, never deployed):
load the SKU, anchor each day, then merge and copy the result over
Keys under 'events' are RobotEvents event IDs. Inside each, keys are
local calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD) — a two-day event with a separate
A visitor's own locally saved anchor overrides whatever is published here.
